question: In Warframe, which primary weapon with no Mastery Rank requirement (MR 0) deals the most damage per shot on its normal attack?
answer:
**MK1-Paris** is my answer. It has no Mastery Rank requirement and deals 230 damage per fully charged shot, or 115 uncharged. The Snipetron is next at 180 per shot, also MR 0.

I didn't check every MR 0 primary. The wiki's weapon data was too long to read in full, and I never saw entries for Boltor, Dread, Penta, Tigris, Simulor, Synapse or Daikyu. The ones I did check are either higher than MR 0 (Vectis MR 2, Tonkor MR 5, Ogris MR 9, Lenz MR 8, Opticor MR 14) or do less damage per shot.

Source: the Warframe Wiki pages for [MK1-Paris](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/MK1-Paris) and [Snipetron](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Snipetron), plus its [primary weapon data](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Module:Weapons/data/primary).
reason: The candidate names MK1-Paris (230 damage) instead of the expected Nataruk with 450 damage, so the main fact is wrong.
